intended_layer: Cross-Layer Integration — Phase 2 (NCTCS→Metatron, Signature→TPT-MTL, Horizon→Dynamics, PhaseMatrix→Metatron)
_design_note: Each case spans two layers. The correct answer requires knowing both layers' invariants AND how the output of one layer gates the other. Candidate texts are layer-neutral — wrong answers are plausible when only one layer's invariant is known. PSE tags encode which candidates correctly propagate the cross-layer constraint. Key traps: (1) accepting a layer's main-report output without artifact reconciliation, (2) confusing 'best available' with 'gate-passed', (3) proceeding with a dependent layer before the prerequisite layer completes, (4) treating a conjunctive gate as a majority vote.

cases.title: NCTCS → Metatron: NCTCS artifact overrides main report (reached_class=C1). Does Metatron G_nctcs pass?

materialization_audit_artifact.authority: ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1 — this artifact overrides the summary report

cross_layer_context.metatron_g_nctcs_requirement: NCTCS reached_class must be >= C2 for G_nctcs=true
cross_layer_context.description: NCTCS ran for the current session. The main conformance report records c2=true and summary reached_class=C3_AuditableTensor. However, MaterializationAudit artifact MaterializationAudit_7f3a records no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation=false for stitch_candidate_7f3a. Under ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1, the machine-readable artifact is authoritative — it overrides the main report. Artifact-corrected reached_class=C1. Metatron's G_nctcs gate requires reached_class >= C2. With artifact-corrected reached_class=C1, G_nctcs=false, making G_meta=false. Metatron returns Diagnostic.

events.message: main_report: c0=true, c1=true, c2=true, c3=true, c4=false -> summary reached_class=C3_AuditableTensor
no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation=false for stitch_candidate_7f3a (tensor updated without Pass gate_report_hash)
ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1: artifact overrides main report -> c2_passed=false -> artifact_corrected reached_class=C1
G_nctcs: artifact_corrected reached_class=C1 < required C2 -> G_nctcs=false -> G_meta=false

candidates.text: G_nctcs=false — the MaterializationAudit artifact (MaterializationAudit_7f3a) records no_direct_fabric_to_tensor_mutation=false, overriding the main report's c2=true under ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1. Artifact-corrected reached_class=C1, which is below Metatron's G_nctcs minimum of C2.
MetatronClosureOutcome::Diagnostic — G_meta=false because G_nctcs=false. No HolisticEigenmodeState may be produced. The Diagnostic report contains the gate report and artifact reconciliation data.

Recovery: resubmit stitch_candidate_7f3a through the NCTCS gate cascade to satisfy C2-GATE-BOUND-MATERIALIZATION, reaching artifact-validated reached_class >= C2. Then retry the Metatron pipeline with the corrected NCTCS conformance result.

G_nctcs=true — the main NCTCS conformance report records c3=true and reached_class=C3_AuditableTensor, which satisfies the G_nctcs minimum of C2. Metatron can accept this conformance result and proceed with gate evaluation.
candidates._trap: The main NCTCS report is overridden by the MaterializationAudit artifact under ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1. Using the main report's C3 claim without artifact reconciliation produces an incorrect G_nctcs value. The artifact-corrected reached_class is C1, not C3.

candidates.text: MetatronClosureOutcome::Closed — the main NCTCS report records C3 which satisfies G_nctcs. If all other Metatron gates pass, a HolisticEigenmodeState can be produced and the closure is complete.
candidates._trap: Closed is impossible when G_meta=false (G_nctcs=false after artifact reconciliation). The fail-closed invariant prohibits HolisticEigenmodeState production when any gate fails.

candidates.text: Produce a HolisticEigenmodeState with validation_status=PendingNctcs to allow downstream layers to continue while the NCTCS issue is resolved in a background reconciliation pass.
candidates._trap: No such HolisticEigenmodeState variant exists. The spec does not permit any HolisticEigenmodeState when G_meta=0. The purpose of the Diagnostic outcome is exactly to carry diagnostic data without producing a closure state.

candidates.text: Override G_nctcs to true in the MetatronGate configuration for this run, deferring artifact reconciliation to a post-closure audit pass that runs after HolisticEigenmodeState production.
candidates._trap: Gate bypass is a spec violation. ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1 reconciliation must happen before gate evaluation. Post-closure auditing does not retroactively validate a gate that was bypassed.

candidates.text: Accept the NCTCS main conformance report as the authoritative input to G_nctcs. The MaterializationAudit is a diagnostic supplement that informs future runs but does not override a signed conformance report for the current Metatron evaluation.
candidates._trap: Direct ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1 violation. Machine-readable artifacts are always authoritative over documentation summaries. The conformance report is the human-readable summary; the artifact is the normative record.

correct_next_actions: G_nctcs=false (ADAMANT Axiom 6.1.1: artifact overrides main report, reached_class=C1 < C2)
resolve NCTCS C2-GATE-BOUND-MATERIALIZATION obligation, then retry Metatron
rejected_false_paths: G_nctcs=true from main report (artifact supremacy violation — Axiom 6.1.1)

cases.title: Signature → TPT-MTL: Signature gate failed. Does the TPT-MTL AdapterGate pass with a blueprint referencing the failed Signature report?

signature_output.best_frontier_blueprint: blueprint_alpha (on NonDominatedFrontier, but SignatureGate overall failed)

cross_layer_context.description: Signature layer ran for the current session. SignatureGate failed: gap_score below minimum and fragmentation above maximum. The NonDominatedFrontier contains blueprint_alpha as the best available blueprint, but the SignatureGate overall did not pass (outcome.passed=false). TPT-MTL was started with blueprint_alpha; the TptMtlRunDescriptor references sig_gate_report_5c9b as the signature gate proof. The TPT-MTL AdapterGate checks that the referenced SignatureGateReport has passed=true. Since sig_gate_report_5c9b.passed=false, AdapterGate=false. outcome_kind: !adapter (priority branch 3) → Recalibrate.

events.message: gap_score FAIL, fragmentation FAIL, degeneracy PASS -> SignatureGateOutcome.passed=false (sig_gate_report_5c9b)

candidates.text: AdapterGate=false — the blueprint's referenced SignatureGateReport (sig_gate_report_5c9b) has passed=false (gap_score and fragmentation both failed the Signature gate). The AdapterGate requires a passed SignatureGateReport; a failed reference is not a valid adapter proof.

TptMtlOutcomeKind::Recalibrate — AdapterGate failure triggers outcome_kind priority branch 3. No TptMtlBundle is emitted. The pipeline requests resubmission with an adjusted configuration (a blueprint backed by a passed Signature gate).

Repair the Signature layer first: tighten lambda_hard coupling to fix fragmentation and refine DeterministicGrid quantization to raise gap_score until SignatureGate.passed=true. Then supply the passing blueprint and its gate report hash to TPT-MTL.

AdapterGate=true — blueprint_alpha was selected from the NonDominatedFrontier, representing the best available structural configuration. Frontier selection constitutes structural validity for TPT-MTL purposes, satisfying the adapter requirement.
candidates._trap: Frontier membership (Pareto dominance) is independent of SignatureGate passage. A blueprint can be the best-on-frontier while the overall Signature gate failed. The AdapterGate checks the gate report, not frontier membership.

candidates.text: TptMtlOutcomeKind::Abort — the adapter gate failure combined with the underlying Signature gate failure constitutes a hard boundary violation, triggering the highest-priority Abort outcome.
candidates._trap: Abort is triggered by BoundaryGate or ReplayGate failure (priority branch 1). AdapterGate failure is priority branch 3 (Recalibrate). No BoundaryGate failure was reported in this TPT-MTL run.

candidates.text: Proceed with the TPT-MTL run using blueprint_alpha despite the AdapterGate failure. The Signature gate failure is a structural quality issue, not a hard blocker — treat it as a soft warning and continue traversal.
candidates._trap: AdapterGate is a hard gate. A failed AdapterGate produces Recalibrate — the spec has no 'soft warning' path that allows traversal to continue with a failed adapter proof.

candidates.text: Use a SignatureGateReport from a previous session where the Signature gate passed. Substitute its hash into the TptMtlRunDescriptor so the AdapterGate receives a passed reference.
candidates._trap: Reusing a gate report from a different session is a cross-layer determinism violation. The gate report must correspond to the current session's evaluation. Substituting a prior-session report produces a non-deterministic proof.

candidates.text: Advance the Signature SearchAutopilot to the Exploitation phase to narrow the search and force commitment of the best frontier blueprint as a passed configuration, bypassing the gate threshold check.
candidates._trap: Autopilot phase advancement changes the search strategy; it does not change whether the SignatureGate passes or fails. Gate evaluation is independent of autopilot phase.

correct_next_actions: AdapterGate=false (referenced sig_gate_report_5c9b.passed=false — frontier membership ≠ gate passage)
repair Signature gate (fragmentation + gap_score), resupply passing report to TPT-MTL
rejected_false_paths: AdapterGate=true from frontier membership (gate checks report, not frontier position)
Abort outcome (BoundaryGate triggers Abort, not AdapterGate — wrong priority branch)

cases.title: Horizon → Dynamics: Horizon G_dual recondensation pending. May Dynamics execute its cycle-N path_delta operations?

cross_layer_context.description: Horizon layer detected G_dual=false for the current session (duality_ok=false). The correct policy — Recondense_duality_coupling — was selected and scheduled, but has NOT yet completed (status=pending). Dynamics has 3 path_delta operations queued, all correctly targeting the current cycle N with causal tags. However, the live graph that Dynamics operates on is derived from the Horizon recondensation output. Without the Horizon recondensation completing, Dynamics would operate on a pre-recondensation graph state that does not reflect the current duality-coupling correction. Dynamics must defer until Horizon recondensation reaches completion_status=done.

events.message: 3 path_delta operations ready (cycle N, causal tags) -> checking Horizon dependency before scheduling
Horizon recondensation_status=pending -> live graph not yet updated -> Dynamics deferred

candidates.text: Defer all Dynamics path_delta operations. The live graph that Dynamics operates on is derived from the Horizon Recondense_duality_coupling output. While recondensation_status=pending, the live graph has not been updated — Dynamics would operate on a pre-recondensation state.

Read the Horizon recondensation status before scheduling Dynamics. Confirm whether Recondense_duality_coupling has reached completion_status=done or is still in pending/in_progress state. Do not schedule Dynamics operations until the status is done.

Execute Horizon Recondense_duality_coupling (the duality-coupling variant, not tension-damping — duality_ok=false was the failing condition) until completion_status=done. Once the live graph is updated with the recondensation result, Dynamics may proceed with its cycle-N operations.

Proceed with the Dynamics cycle-N path_delta operations. The operations are correctly tagged as causal and target the current cycle N — these invariants confirm the operations are valid. The Horizon recondensation runs in a separate pipeline and has no blocking dependency on Dynamics scheduling.
candidates._trap: Correct cycle-N tags verify that the operations reference the right cycle, but they cannot verify that the live graph itself is post-recondensation. The architectural dependency (Horizon output → Dynamics input graph) is independent of whether the operations are cycle-correct.

candidates.text: Use the cached pre-recondensation graph state as the Dynamics input for cycle N. This represents the last confirmed valid graph state and allows Dynamics to proceed while Horizon completes asynchronously.
candidates._trap: The pre-recondensation graph is stale: it does not reflect the duality-coupling correction that Horizon's recondensation produces. Applying path_delta operations to this stale state would diverge from the correct post-recondensation topology.

candidates.text: Run Dynamics path_delta operations and Horizon Recondense_duality_coupling concurrently to reduce total pipeline latency. Dynamics and Horizon operate on separate graph representations and can safely be parallelised.
candidates._trap: Dynamics requires a completed Horizon recondensation as the source of its live graph. Concurrent execution allows Dynamics to read intermediate graph states that are not yet valid recondensation outputs, producing a race condition on the live graph.

candidates.text: Apply Recondense_tension_damping instead of Recondense_duality_coupling to complete the Horizon step faster. Tension damping has lower computational cost and will unblock Dynamics sooner.
candidates._trap: Recondense_tension_damping targets the tension_ok dimension. The Horizon G_dual failure had duality_ok=false (tension_ok=true). Applying the wrong sub-variant leaves duality_ok=false even after recondensation — G_dual remains false and the live graph is still not updated correctly.

candidates.text: Skip Horizon recondensation if the Dynamics path_delta operations pass their own gate checks. Dynamics gate passage is evidence that the graph input is structurally valid, making the Horizon completion a non-blocking prerequisite.
candidates._trap: Dynamics gates verify the operations against the graph they receive — they cannot detect whether that graph was derived from a pre- or post-recondensation state. A Dynamics gate pass on a stale graph does not validate the Horizon dependency.

correct_next_actions: defer Dynamics until Horizon Recondense_duality_coupling completes (live graph not yet updated)
inspect Horizon recondensation_status before scheduling Dynamics
execute Horizon Recondense_duality_coupling (duality variant, not tension) to completion
rejected_false_paths: use_pre_recondensation_cached_graph (stale — does not reflect duality-coupling correction)

cases.title: Phase Matrix → Metatron: Phase Matrix submitted 5 CouplingUpdates (2 with DeterminismViolation). Does Metatron G_trace pass?

phase_matrix_output.violation_detail: updates coupling_update_delta and coupling_update_epsilon reference StitcherGateReports from cycle N-1 (passed=true but wrong cycle)

cross_layer_context.metatron_g_trace_requirement: all CouplingUpdates in submitted trace must carry same-cycle (cycle N) StitcherGateReport references; G_trace is conjunctive — one DeterminismViolation fails the gate
cross_layer_context.description: Phase Matrix completed a batch of 5 CouplingUpdates for the current session. 3 updates (alpha, beta, gamma) reference current-cycle N StitcherGateReports with passed=true — these are valid. 2 updates (delta, epsilon) reference prior-cycle N-1 StitcherGateReports with passed=true — these are DeterminismViolations (passed=true but wrong cycle). Metatron's G_trace gate verifies that all submitted CouplingUpdates carry same-cycle gate references. G_trace is conjunctive — a single DeterminismViolation in the submitted batch fails G_trace. With G_trace=false, G_meta=false, and Metatron returns Diagnostic.

events.message: submitting 5 CouplingUpdates to Metatron trace: alpha(N), beta(N), gamma(N), delta(N-1), epsilon(N-1)
G_trace check: coupling_update_delta -> StitcherGateReport cycle=N-1 -> DeterminismViolation; coupling_update_epsilon -> cycle=N-1 -> DeterminismViolation
G_trace=false (2 DeterminismViolations in submitted batch) -> G_meta=false -> Diagnostic

candidates.text: G_trace=false — coupling_update_delta and coupling_update_epsilon reference StitcherGateReports from cycle N-1 (DeterminismViolation). G_trace is conjunctive: all submitted CouplingUpdates must carry same-cycle gate references. Two violations fail the gate regardless of how many valid updates are present.

MetatronClosureOutcome::Diagnostic — G_meta=false because G_trace=false. No HolisticEigenmodeState may be produced. The Diagnostic report contains the G_trace failure analysis including the two DeterminismViolation update IDs.

Recovery: remove coupling_update_delta and coupling_update_epsilon from the Phase Matrix batch (they reference cycle N-1 gate reports). Resubmit the batch with only the 3 current-cycle N updates (alpha, beta, gamma). With all submitted updates carrying cycle-N gate references, G_trace can pass on retry.
G_trace=true — 3 of the 5 submitted CouplingUpdates carry current-cycle N gate references with passed=true. A majority of valid updates satisfies the G_trace conjunctive requirement.
candidates._trap: G_trace is a conjunctive gate, not a majority vote. 'All CouplingUpdates must be deterministic' means any single DeterminismViolation in the submitted batch fails G_trace. 3/5 valid is not sufficient — the gate requires 5/5.

candidates.text: Metatron G_trace accepts the partial trace by filtering out coupling_update_delta and coupling_update_epsilon internally. The 3 valid updates are used to produce the HolisticEigenmodeState while the 2 violations are logged in the diagnostic record.
candidates._trap: Metatron does not filter the submitted trace. G_trace evaluates the batch as submitted — it is a binary pass/fail on the submitted set. Filtering must happen in the Phase Matrix layer before submission, not inside Metatron.

candidates.text: MetatronClosureOutcome::Closed — the 3 valid CouplingUpdates (alpha, beta, gamma) are sufficient to produce a HolisticEigenmodeState. The 2 DeterminismViolation updates are flagged in an attached diagnostic report but do not block closure.
candidates._trap: Impossible. G_meta=false (G_trace=false). Fail-closed invariant: no HolisticEigenmodeState may be produced when any gate fails, regardless of how many updates were valid.

candidates.text: Update the cycle field in the N-1 StitcherGateReports for coupling_update_delta and coupling_update_epsilon, aligning them with cycle N so G_trace can pass without resubmitting the batch.
candidates._trap: StitcherGateReports are immutable once issued. Their cycle field is a record of the evaluation cycle in which they were produced. Retroactive modification is a different form of DeterminismViolation — it falsifies the provenance record.

candidates.text: G_replay passed for all 5 CouplingUpdates, confirming replay determinism. Since G_replay already verified determinism, G_trace should be treated as satisfied — the gates test the same underlying property.
candidates._trap: G_trace and G_replay are distinct gates. G_replay verifies replay identity (the output is byte-identical when replayed). G_trace verifies trace determinism including same-cycle gate references. G_replay passage does not imply G_trace passage.

correct_next_actions: G_trace=false (2 CouplingUpdates with cycle N-1 references — DeterminismViolation; G_trace is conjunctive)
purge N-1 CouplingUpdates from Phase Matrix batch, resubmit cycle-N-only batch
rejected_false_paths: G_trace=true from majority (conjunctive gate ≠ majority vote — 5/5 required, not 3/5)
Metatron_filters_invalid_updates (Metatron evaluates as-submitted; filtering is a Phase Matrix responsibility)
Metatron Closed with 3 valid updates (G_meta=false → impossible; fail-closed invariant)
